programs.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
programs.desc: Orphaned Harry Potter is raised by his Uncle Vernon and Aunt Petunia.His guardians don't care about him, and his cousin Dudley constantly teases him.One day, a mysterious letter arrives to Harry.His relatives do not allow him to read it because it reveals the secret of his origins.However, on his eleventh birthday, the boy learns the truth.It turns out that he is the son of a pair of magicians who were killed by the wizard Voldemort.To his surprise, Harry also discovers that he has inherited extraordinary abilities from his parents.He receives an invitation to study at Hogwarts, the school of magic.His life changes completely.Once there, Harry is surprised to discover that he is famous in the wizarding community.At school, he makes friends with his peers, Ron and Hermione.Together with them, he tries to discover the secret of the philosopher's stone hidden within the walls of the academy.They experience many adventures together.Potter must face the enemy who contributed to the death of his loved ones.

programs.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
programs.desc: A new school year begins at Hogwarts, the famous wizarding school.Harry Potter and his friend Ron Weasley have been unlucky from the beginning.They miss their train, so they take a flying car to get there.Unfortunately, they cause a crash, which angers Prof.Snape.It turns out that last year's feat, neutralizing Lord Voldemort, made Harry a hero.The young wizard is not happy about his sudden popularity.It does not help him concentrate on his studies and even makes enemies, including among teachers.Meanwhile, prof.Dumbledore warns that evil lurks within the walls of the academy.An ominous writing appears on the wall, declaring that the Chamber of Secrets has been opened.Students and teachers are in danger.Potter must find out what got out of the chamber and defeat the dark forces that have taken over Hogwarts.He is helped by his friends, Ron and Hermione.

programs.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programs.desc: Paris, 1930s. The son of immigrants takes part in a theater performance.This is how he discovers his vocal talent and decides to become a singer.A breakthrough in his career was his meeting with Edith Piaf.

programs.title: Fox \u0026 Hare Save the Forest
programs.desc: To the surprise of the forest inhabitants, a lake suddenly appears in place of a small stream.There is more and more water every day and it is dangerously close to the habitats of anxious animals.As if the problems weren't enough, one of the neighbors, Henio the owl, disappears, and the neighborhood begins to be terrorized by mischievous rats.It quickly comes to light that the beaver and the dam it built are responsible for the creation of the reservoir.Forest friends, Felek the fox and Tola the bunny, must convince the stubborn builder to stop the investment.If they don't act quickly, their forest will drown.Based on the book series by Sylvia Vanden Heede.

programs.title: Red One
programs.desc: The third joint film of Jake Kasdan and Dwayne Johnson, after two installments of the new version of "Jumanji".The head of North Pole security and a bounty hunter search for the missing Santa Claus.

programs.title: Everest
programs.desc: The year 1996. Rob Hall (Jason Clarke) organizes a commercial expedition to the highest mountain in the world.His brigade includes, among others:Texan Beck Weathers (Josh Brolin) and reporter Jon Krakauer (Michael Kelly).The mountaineers reach the base camp.Over the course of several weeks, they get used to extreme weather conditions and pressure that disregulates the body.Apart from them, other teams are heading to the summit.Hall makes a strategic decision to join Scott Fischer (Jake Gyllenhaal), the head of the Mountain Madness expedition.At the beginning of May, climbers leave the base camp.They struggle with snow storms, bitter cold and lack of oxygen.Extreme conditions put them at the edge of their mental and physical endurance.

programs.title: The Accountant 2
programs.desc: Mathematical genius Christian Wolff (Ben Affleck) has a talent for solving complex numerical puzzles.One day, his old friend is murdered.It leaves behind a mysterious message "Find an accountant".Wolff begins a private investigation.He recruits his brother, Brax (Jon Bernthal), to help him.Together with the deputy director of the US Treasury, Marybeth Medina (Cynthia Addai-Robinson), they uncover a sinister conspiracy.They become the target of assassins who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets hidden.Sequel to Gavin O'Connor's 2016 film.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 3
programs.desc: There is a civil war in the kingdom of Westeros.The dragon-ruling House Targaryen is embroiled in a fratricidal fight for the succession to King Viserys.The parties to the dispute are the ruler's daughter Rhaenyra (Emma D'Arcy), her half-brother Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney), who took over the Iron Throne as a result of the conspiracy, and their allies - the Black and Green parties.A bloody, devastating conflict called the Dance of Dragons begins the fall of the Targaryen family.The series presents events taking place 200 years before the story told in "Game of Thrones".

programs.title: Gaisrai
programs.desc: Anna Arnardóttir, a renowned volcanologist, notices signs of dangerous eruptions near Reykjavík.Despite the warnings, the authorities do not believe her.The affair with the photographer also complicates the woman's private life.

programs.title: The Fountain
programs.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programs.title: Frieda's Case
programs.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programs.title: Drag Me to Hell
programs.desc: Los Angeles.Christine Brown (Alison Lohman) works in a bank in the lending department and successfully climbs the career ladder.One day, an unusual client comes to her, an old and strange-looking gypsy girl, Sylvia Ganush (Lorna Raver).She asks for help in postponing the mortgage installment payment date.When Christine refuses to fulfill the order, the furious old woman curses her.He only has three days to remove the charm.After this time, the terrifying demon Lamia will take her to hell... An effective, suspenseful horror film, successfully combining elements of horror and black humor.The film was directed by Sam Raimi, author of the cult "Evil Dead", three parts of "Spider-Man" and "The Grudge" trilogy.
